sentences.en: Oh my god, I'm a slut.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我简直是个香水狂。

sentences.en: I wear a bunch of different stuff.
sentences.zh: 我用的香水种类挺杂的。

sentences.en: I've never worn the same perfume two days in a row.
sentences.zh: 我从来不会连续两天用同一款香水。

sentences.en: She's a staff writer for The New Yorker
sentences.zh: 她是《纽约客》的特约撰稿人，

sentences.en: and one of the most genuinely glamorous people I have ever met.
sentences.zh: 也是我见过最货真价实的魅力女性之一。

sentences.en: So she always smells like some perfume or another.
sentences.zh: 所以她身上总会散发着某种香水的味道。

sentences.en: I love like Dior Poison and Anais Anais
sentences.zh: 我喜欢迪奥的“毒药”和安妮·安妮（Anais Anais），

sentences.en: and I love wearing number five in the highest concentration as the oil
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢用浓度最高的香精版五号香水，

sentences.en: and I like tuberose and I love gardenia
sentences.zh: 我喜欢晚香玉，也爱栀子花，

sentences.en: and I love it to be like a cloud of that around you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种被香气包裹的感觉。

sentences.en: I was the opposite of Rachel.
I would spritz some on at the airport sometimes
sentences.zh: 有时在机场我会喷一点，

sentences.en: but mostly I just found it all smelled perfumey.
sentences.zh: 但大部分时候，我只觉得它们闻起来都一股“香水味”。

sentences.en: I don't think I can smell...
On paper, everything just smells like chemicals to me.
sentences.zh: 在试香纸上，对我来说一切都闻起来像化学试剂。

sentences.en: Yeah, well it needs a moment to dry down.
sentences.zh: 是啊，不过香水需要一点时间来挥发沉淀。

sentences.en: I wanted to figure out what I was missing.
sentences.zh: 我想弄明白我到底错过了什么。

sentences.en: So I asked Rachel to take me perfume shopping at Sephora.
sentences.zh: 于是我请瑞秋带我去丝芙兰逛香水。

sentences.en: Hence the annoying pop music you hear in the background.
sentences.zh: 所以背景里才会有那些恼人的流行音乐。

sentences.en: I'm like, I can't describe it.
And then there's a little ginger on the top.
sentences.zh: 然后前调里有一点生姜味。

sentences.en: Whatever Rachel was experiencing, I wasn't getting it.
sentences.zh: 不管瑞秋感受到了什么，我反正是一点没体会到。

sentences.en: It was like I was trying to fudge my way through a wine tasting
sentences.zh: 我就像是在硬着头皮参加品酒会，

sentences.en: by being like, oh yeah, this one has overtones of grape.
sentences.zh: 假装说：“噢，没错，这款酒有葡萄的余韵。”

sentences.en: I guess it just smells chemically to me.
sentences.zh: 我猜对我来说它闻起来就是化学味。

sentences.en: Like it smells like cleaning solution to me, you know?
sentences.zh: 就像清洁剂的味道，你懂吗？

sentences.en: I thought perfume was a kind of snake oil.
sentences.zh: 我一直以为香水就是某种“蛇油”（骗人的把戏）。

sentences.en: But basically the only thing separating one perfume from another
sentences.zh: 毕竟区分不同香水的唯一标准，

sentences.en: was the design of the bottle and the name of the brand.
sentences.zh: 似乎就是瓶子的设计和品牌名称。

sentences.en: I thought perfume was just a way for big fashion labels to make money.
sentences.zh: 我以为香水只是大牌时装屋赚钱的手段。

sentences.en: Like Chanel makes a ton of money from fragrance.
sentences.zh: 比如香奈儿就靠香水赚了大钱。

sentences.en: The places where basically like people can't always afford the thing
sentences.zh: 在那些人们买不起高定成衣的地方，

sentences.en: but they can afford the perfume.
It's like people's gateway drug to get into the branding.
sentences.zh: 这就像是人们接触品牌文化的“入门毒品”。

sentences.en: And so I was ready to make a story that would be like,
sentences.zh: 所以我准备写一篇报道，主题就是：

sentences.en: wake up people, perfume is a ruse.
sentences.zh: 醒醒吧各位，香水就是个骗局。

sentences.en: You're getting fleeced for a name in the packaging.
sentences.zh: 你们只是在为包装上的名字买单。

sentences.en: You know, I really admire and think a lot about the artistry
sentences.zh: 你知道，我其实非常钦佩香水制作背后的艺术性，

sentences.en: Even, you know, any of these designer perfumes.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是那些设计师香水也一样。

sentences.en: This is what Rachel knew that I had yet to find out.
sentences.zh: 这就是瑞秋知道而我还没发现的事实。

sentences.en: Perfume is a key to a whole other dimension
that we've all collectively denied and forgotten.
sentences.zh: 一个我们集体否定并遗忘了的维度。

sentences.en: A show about what we wear.
sentences.zh: 一档关于我们穿什么的节目。
人们没意识到这是一种幻想。

sentences.en: There's always this thing that you have to work extra hard to get.
sentences.zh: 总有些东西是你必须付出额外努力才能得到的。

sentences.en: No one dresses like a king anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在没人像国王那样穿衣服了。

sentences.en: That's how I make money, love.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，我就是这么赚钱的。

sentences.en: There are lots of things that we take for granted
sentences.zh: 有很多我们习以为常的东西，

sentences.en: that would once have been considered luxuries.
If someone forced you to surrender one of your five senses,
sentences.zh: 如果有人强迫你放弃五感中的一种，

sentences.en: you'd probably handily give up your sense of smell.
sentences.zh: 你大概会毫不犹豫地放弃嗅觉。

sentences.en: We talk about how foods are umami or spicy
sentences.zh: 我们谈论食物时会说它鲜美或辛辣，

sentences.en: or how music can be soothing or energizing or cacophonous.
sentences.zh: 谈论音乐时会说它舒缓、激昂或嘈杂。

sentences.en: But with scent, we don't really analyze it with a lot of nuance.
sentences.zh: 但对于气味，我们并没有进行太多细致的分析。

sentences.en: The question is usually black or white.
Do you like this scent or not?
We just don't have a lot of tools to analyze smells,
sentences.zh: 我们在语言或科学上，确实缺乏分析气味的工具。
事实上，目前还没有办法评估气味的“强度”。

sentences.en: In fact, there is no way to assess the volume of a scent.
sentences.zh: 没有任何仪器能测量气味等级。

sentences.en: There are no instruments that can measure odor levels.
sentences.zh: 我们有能测量气味羽流中化学成分的仪器，

sentences.en: We have instruments that can measure the chemicals that are in an odor plume,
sentences.zh: 但至少在目前，这并不能转化为，

sentences.en: but that doesn't translate into, at least not at the present time,
sentences.zh: 个人对气味的真实体验。

sentences.en: into what the odor experience is for any individual.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉·道尔顿（Pamela Dalton）是一位资深科学家，

sentences.en: Pamela Dalton is a senior scientist
sentences.zh: 就职于费城的莫奈尔化学感官中心。

sentences.en: at the Monell Chemical Senses Center in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 但我跟她通话时，她不在费城。

sentences.en: But when I talked to her, she was not in Philly.
sentences.zh: 她是在芝加哥的一个会议室里跟我通话的。

sentences.en: She was talking to me from a conference room in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我在这儿是为了参加一场取证会。
我偶尔会担任专家证人，

sentences.en: I do expert witness work from time to time,
sentences.zh: 这次是一起涉及垃圾填埋场投诉的气味案件。

sentences.en: and this is an odor case involving people's complaints around a landfill.
sentences.zh: 在涉及气味的法律案件中，
他们必须聘请专业的“鼻子”来做出非常主观的判断。

sentences.en: they have to hire professional noses to make very subjective calls.
sentences.zh: 而且帕梅拉并不是什么超人。

sentences.en: And it's not like Pamela is a superhuman.
sentences.zh: 通常来说，人类的嗅觉相当灵敏。

sentences.en: Generally, people are pretty good at smelling.
sentences.zh: 比我们自认为的要好得多。

sentences.en: Much better than we think we are.
sentences.zh: 当空气中只有十亿分之一的香料分子时，我们也能闻到，

sentences.en: We can smell things when there's one or two parts of a fragrance material
sentences.zh: 这真的是非常、非常微小的浓度。

sentences.en: in a billion parts of air, which is really, really tiny.
sentences.zh: 所以我们比自己想象的更敏感。

sentences.en: So we're more sensitive than we believe.
sentences.zh: 你知道，狗可能对一系列化合物很敏感，

sentences.en: You know, dogs may be sensitive to a range of compounds,
sentences.zh: 但人类对环境中更多样化的化学物质有着更强的敏感度。

sentences.en: but humans have much more sensitivity to a much more diverse set of chemicals in the environment.
sentences.zh: 但我们不像狗或其他动物那样使用嗅觉。

sentences.en: But we don't use scent the way dogs and other animals do.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是我们要直立行走。

sentences.en: And in part, it's because we're bipedal.
sentences.zh: 很简单，我们的鼻子进化得离地面更远了。

sentences.en: Our noses, quite simply, evolved to be farther away from the earth.
sentences.zh: 我们现在距离地面有四到六英尺高，

sentences.en: We're now at four to five to six feet above the ground,
sentences.zh: 所以我们闻到的东西也不一样了，对吧？

sentences.en: so we're smelling different things, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不再像四肢着地爬行时那样去闻东西了。

sentences.en: We're not smelling things as we were when we were loathing around on all fours.
sentences.zh: 不过，偶尔我们还是会抬起鼻子嗅一嗅空气。

sentences.en: Yet, still, on occasion, we'll lift our noses to the air and take a sniff.
sentences.zh: 只是更多时候，我们只关注那些带来威胁的气味。

sentences.en: It's just that more often than not, we pay attention to smells that present a threat.

sentences.zh: 如果发生火灾或煤气泄漏。

sentences.en: If there's a fire or a gas leak.

sentences.zh: 所以我们学会了，你知道，我们要远离那些气味。

sentences.en: And so we learned that, you know, we want to stay away from those kinds of voters.
sentences.zh: 我们已经习惯将气味与原始且不悦的事物联系在一起。

sentences.en: We've come to associate scent with something primal and unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 如果你问：“嘿，我身上有味道吗？”

sentences.en: If you ask, hey, do I smell?
sentences.zh: 大家的默认假设就是那是个坏事。

sentences.en: The collective assumption is that that's a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 我们想要避免气味，避免去闻。

sentences.en: We want to avoid smells and smelling.
sentences.zh: 这种心态可以追溯到西方的一系列哲学家，

sentences.en: And this mentality goes back to a number of philosophers in the West,
sentences.zh: 从柏拉图到亚里士多德再到康德，

sentences.en: from Plato to Aristotle to Kant,
sentences.zh: 他们都嘲笑嗅觉是低级的、次要的。

sentences.en: who derided our sense of smell as base and secondary.

sentences.zh: 从历史上看，它是我们最不受尊重的感官。

sentences.en: Historically, it has been the least respected of our senses.
sentences.zh: 所以很多人干脆试图忽略它。

sentences.en: And so a lot of folks just try to ignore it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为作为一个物种，我们低估了自己，

sentences.en: But I think as a species, we have discounted
sentences.zh: 我们确实能在极其微小的浓度下闻到许多化学物质。

sentences.en: that we really can smell a lot of chemicals at vanishingly trivial concentrations.
sentences.zh: 我们有能力闻到十亿分之一浓度的气味，

sentences.en: So we have the capacity to smell things in the parts per billions,
sentences.zh: 但我们缺乏谈论它们的能力。

sentences.en: but we lack the capacity to talk about them.
sentences.zh: 所以学习嗅觉的很大一部分，在于学习如何描述气味。

sentences.en: So much of learning to smell comes from learning how to describe smells.
So I was at a party.
sentences.zh: 一位女士走进来，拥抱了每个人，

sentences.en: A woman came in who was hugging everybody,

sentences.zh: 很多人都告诉她她闻起来很香。

sentences.en: and a number of people told her that she smelled good.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我可以告诉你她用的是哪个特定品牌，

sentences.en: And I said, okay, I can tell you that she's wearing this particular brand,
and it's from this many years ago,
sentences.zh: 她闻起来之所以让人感到舒适温暖，是因为里面含有大量的紫罗兰酮，

sentences.en: and the reason that she smells cozy and snug is because it's got a lot of ionones in it,
sentences.zh: 而且她闻起来有点像鸢尾根，

sentences.en: and she smells sort of like oris,
sentences.zh: 也就是佛罗伦萨鸢尾花的陈年根茎，

sentences.en: which is the aged root of the Florentine iris flower,
sentences.zh: 它有一种粉质感，所以她闻起来就像一个拥抱。

sentences.en: and it's got sort of a powdery feeling, so she smells like a hug.
And everyone's looking at me, and I was like,
sentences.zh: 我闻到的并不比你们多。

sentences.en: I'm not smelling any more than you are.
sentences.zh: 我闻到的并不比你们多。

sentences.en: I just have the words to tell you
what the brand is when it came out and what's in it.
sentences.zh: 关于这个品牌是什么时候出现的，以及它里面有什么成分。

sentences.en: Miranda Gordon is the vice president of marketing at Mon.
sentences.zh: 米兰达·戈登是 Mon 公司的市场副总裁。

sentences.en: Mon is a fragrance company because the lion's share of the hundreds and hundreds of designer perfumes
sentences.zh: Mon 是一家香水公司，因为每年推出的成百上千款设计师香水，其中绝大部分

sentences.en: that come out each year are made by the same dozen or so companies.
sentences.zh: 都是由那十几家公司制造的。

sentences.en: Mon has made perfumes for Banana Republic and Armani
sentences.zh: Mon 曾为香蕉共和国和阿玛尼制作过香水，

sentences.en: and a ton of scents for really widespread popular brands you definitely know,
sentences.zh: 也为许多你肯定知道的流行大众品牌制作过大量香氛，

sentences.en: For some brands, it's a dirty secret that they contract out their scents to other companies.
sentences.zh: 对某些品牌来说，将香氛外包给其他公司是一个不可告人的秘密。

sentences.en: But I don't think there should be any shame in it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这没什么好羞耻的。

sentences.en: Because sure, most of us have the potential to get really good at smelling,
sentences.zh: 因为当然，我们大多数人都有潜力在嗅觉上变得非常敏锐，

sentences.en: but actually designing a perfume is something entirely different.
sentences.zh: 但真正设计一款香水是完全不同的事情。

sentences.en: It's like composing a piece of music or choreographing a dance.
sentences.zh: 这就像创作一首乐曲或编排一支舞蹈。

sentences.en: And the professionals make it look easy.
sentences.zh: 而专业人士让它看起来很简单。

sentences.en: Some perfume ingredients can be very straightforward.
sentences.zh: 有些香水成分非常直观。

sentences.en: Like if you're trying to use a citrus scent, that's pretty easy to get.
sentences.zh: 比如如果你想用柑橘味，那很容易得到。

sentences.en: That scent is extracted from the peel of the fruit with cold pressing.
sentences.zh: 这种香味是通过冷压法从果皮中提取出来的。

sentences.en: The same way we make olive oil, we can make grapefruit oil or lemon oil or lime oil or mandarin oil.
sentences.zh: 就像我们制作橄榄油一样，我们可以制作葡萄柚油、柠檬油、青柠油或柑橘油。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of scents that you can't just get.
sentences.zh: 但有很多香味是你无法直接获得的。

sentences.en: You can't just press the oil of a mango or a strawberry or a pear or an apple.
sentences.zh: 你不能直接压榨出芒果、草莓、梨或苹果的油。

sentences.en: Like if you pressed an apple peel, you wouldn't get apple oil, you would get apple juice,
sentences.zh: 比如如果你压榨苹果皮，你得到的不是苹果油，而是苹果汁，

sentences.en: which is not very fragrant and you wouldn't want to dab that on yourself.
sentences.zh: 那并没有什么香味，你也不会想把它涂在身上。

sentences.en: So there are many, many scents that perfumers have to build.
sentences.zh: 所以调香师必须构建出许多许多种香味。

sentences.en: There are chemicals that have an apple odor to them.
sentences.zh: 有一些化学物质具有苹果的气味。

sentences.en: Gino Percantino is one of the perfumers at Marn.
sentences.zh: 吉诺·佩坎蒂诺是 Marn 公司的调香师之一。

sentences.en: If he wants to make an apple scent, he will gather a bunch of smells together.
sentences.zh: 如果他想制作一种苹果味，他会把一堆气味组合在一起。
也就是一些调香师所说的“香调”。

sentences.en: Combining and mixing those notes to get an authentic apple smell.
sentences.zh: 通过组合和混合这些香调来获得真实的苹果味。

sentences.en: And a group of notes makes an accord.
sentences.zh: 而一组香调就构成了一个“香协”。

sentences.en: An accord is a group of ingredients that's usually less than 10 ingredients to try to emulate a specific thing.
sentences.zh: 香协是一组通常少于 10 种成分的原料，旨在模拟某种特定的事物。

sentences.en: And there's no one set apple accord.
sentences.zh: 而且没有一种固定的苹果香协。

sentences.en: Every perfumer has their own way to make it.
sentences.zh: 每位调香师都有自己的制作方法。

sentences.en: Think of it like Gino is painting a picture of an apple.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它想象成吉诺在画一幅苹果的画。

sentences.en: The apple could be slightly fermented.
sentences.zh: 苹果可能稍微有点发酵。

sentences.en: It could be a yellow apple or a green apple.
sentences.zh: 它可以是黄苹果或青苹果。

sentences.en: It could be in a tree.
It could be in a pie.
Listen to how Gino renders a fig.
sentences.zh: 听听吉诺是如何呈现无花果味的。

sentences.en: Which is another one of those scents you have to build note by note.
sentences.zh: 这也是那种必须逐个香调构建的香味之一。

sentences.en: Fig is always fun for me because I often work from some of my best coconut.
sentences.zh: 无花果对我来说总是很有趣，因为我经常从我最好的椰子味中进行创作。

sentences.en: So I'm not talking about like pina colada with pineapple and all that.
sentences.zh: 我不是指那种加了菠萝之类的椰林飘香。

sentences.en: Just the creamy kind of coconut.
sentences.zh: 只是那种奶油味的椰子。

sentences.en: If you dial it back and put more pulp into it, a little more juiciness into it, a little more green with some extra woods.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它调淡一点，加入更多的果肉，增加一点多汁感，再加一点带有额外木质感的绿色调。

sentences.en: Because you want that stemmy element of it.
sentences.zh: 因为你需要那种茎秆的元素。

sentences.en: And then you've turned a coconut into a fig.
sentences.zh: 然后你就把椰子变成了无花果。

sentences.en: And that's the part that's technically impressive.
sentences.zh: 这就是技术上令人印象深刻的部分。

sentences.en: But making a perfume is not just about rendering a good, believable fig.
sentences.zh: 但制作香水不仅仅是呈现出一种好的、可信的无花果味。

sentences.en: It's then using that fig in a way that's interesting and new.
sentences.zh: 关键在于以一种有趣且新颖的方式使用这种无花果味。

sentences.en: So Gino could situate the fig in a scent that's smoky and leathery or something powdery and floral or something lush and green.
sentences.zh: 所以吉诺可以将无花果置于一种烟熏皮革味、粉质花香调，或是郁郁葱葱的绿叶调中。

sentences.en: Or include an ingredient that I would have never considered.
sentences.zh: 或者加入一种我从未考虑过的成分。

sentences.en: My favorite ingredient is Szechuan pepper.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的成分是四川花椒。

sentences.en: It has a little spicy element.
There's a virtuosity in professional perfume.
sentences.zh: 专业香水有一种精湛的技艺。

sentences.en: That's the difference between, say, an essential oil from a health food store and a perfume.
sentences.zh: 这就是健康食品店的精油与香水之间的区别。

sentences.en: It's the difference between the pleasure of a single ripe peach and the pleasure of an exquisitely executed risotto.
sentences.zh: 这就像品尝一颗成熟桃子的乐趣与享用一道精心烹制的意大利烩饭的乐趣之间的区别。

sentences.en: Professional perfume is artistry and intuition and a lot of hard science.
sentences.zh: 专业香水是艺术、直觉和大量硬科学的结合。

sentences.en: Because some combinations just don't work on a molecular level.
sentences.zh: 因为有些组合在分子层面上就是行不通的。

sentences.en: If you don't know what you're doing and you take the smell of blackcurrant and the smell of rhubarb and you put it together in a test tube,
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道自己在做什么，把黑加仑的味道和大黄的味道放在试管里混合，

sentences.en: things are going to interact with the molecular level and it's going to smell like the cat pissed on your weed.
sentences.zh: 它们会在分子层面上发生反应，闻起来就像猫尿在了你的大麻上一样。

sentences.en: In Mann's laboratory in midtown Manhattan, perfumers and technicians were busily mixing drops from a selection of hundreds and hundreds of notes.
sentences.zh: 在曼哈顿中城的曼恩实验室里，调香师和技术人员正忙着从数百种香调中混合滴剂。

sentences.en: The smell of the laboratory was incredible.
sentences.zh: 实验室里的气味令人难以置信。

sentences.en: It wasn't like a perfume counter in a department store.
sentences.zh: 它不像百货公司的香水柜台。

sentences.en: That smells like 50 top 40 radio stations blasting at once.
sentences.zh: 那里闻起来就像 50 个热门电台同时在播放。

sentences.en: Mann's laboratory smells like an orchestra of raw possibilities, composed of both natural and synthetic ingredients.
sentences.zh: 曼恩实验室闻起来像是一个由天然和合成成分组成的原始可能性的管弦乐队。

sentences.en: And without derailing this whole story, let me just say there are some controversies in there.
sentences.zh: 在不偏离主题的情况下，我只想说这里面存在一些争议。

sentences.en: Perfume ingredients are considered trade secrets, so they aren't listed on the bottle.
sentences.zh: 香水成分被视为商业机密，所以它们不会列在瓶子上。

sentences.en: And this opacity has caused some worry, because there are ingredients, natural and synthetic alike, that can trigger allergic reactions.
sentences.zh: 这种不透明性引起了一些担忧，因为无论是天然还是合成成分，都有可能引发过敏反应。

sentences.en: And some animal studies have found fragrance chemicals that are probable carcinogens or have been linked to liver, kidney, and lung damage.
sentences.zh: 一些动物研究发现，某些香氛化学物质可能是致癌物，或与肝脏、肾脏和肺部损伤有关。

sentences.en: The perfume industry says that all of the ingredients they use are at such low concentration that they aren't dangerous to human health.
sentences.zh: 香水行业表示，他们使用的所有成分浓度都非常低，不会对人体健康造成危险。

sentences.en: But there have been calls to set more limits on the materials perfumers can use.
sentences.zh: 但一直有呼声要求对调香师使用的材料设置更多限制。

sentences.en: And sure enough, every now and then, an ingredient gets pulled off the market.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，时不时就会有一种成分被撤出市场。

sentences.en: I look at it as if they're doing some kind of testing with ingredients and they're being a little restrictive.
sentences.zh: 我把它看作是他们正在对成分进行某种测试，而且他们有点限制性。

sentences.en: I think there's some value to that, if it's going to help humanity in some way.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果这能以某种方式帮助人类，那是有价值的。

sentences.en: It ties my hands a little bit on trying to be creative.
sentences.zh: 这在尝试创新时确实束缚了我的手脚。

sentences.en: Gino is operating within a set of constantly shifting constraints.
sentences.zh: 吉诺是在一套不断变化的限制条件下工作的。

sentences.en: Instruments are being removed from Mann's orchestra all the time.
sentences.zh: 曼恩的管弦乐队中的乐器一直在被移除。

sentences.en: By the different regulatory laws of every country, yes, but also by an ingredient's availability.
sentences.zh: 不仅是因为各国不同的监管法律，还因为成分的可用性。

sentences.en: When a certain scent becomes trendy, it becomes harder to procure.
sentences.zh: 当某种香味变得流行时，它就变得更难采购了。
这是一种美味的天然香气。

sentences.en: There's a drop of Indian sandalwood in pretty much everything on the market.
sentences.zh: 市场上几乎所有的产品里都有一滴印度檀香。

sentences.en: And the challenge with Indian sandalwood is that the trees have to be at least 30 years old before you can harvest them.
sentences.zh: 而印度檀香的挑战在于，树木必须至少生长 30 年才能采收。

sentences.en: You can't just go plant more trees and have more oil tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是去种更多的树，明天就能有更多的油。

sentences.en: So Indian sandalwood had to be replaced with Australian sandalwood, which doesn't smell the same,
sentences.zh: 所以印度檀香不得不被澳大利亚檀香取代，但味道不一样，

sentences.en: or with synthetic sandalwood, which doesn't smell the same.
sentences.zh: 或者被合成檀香取代，味道也不一样。

sentences.en: So making a new perfume isn't just unbridled creativity.
sentences.zh: 所以制作一款新香水不仅仅是肆无忌惮的创造力。

sentences.en: It's limited by a lot of factors.
sentences.zh: 它受到很多因素的限制。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, the scent has to sell.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这种香味必须好卖。

sentences.en: Mann's brilliant perfumers probably aren't going to make something that smells like fig and Szechuan peppers.
sentences.zh: 曼恩那些才华横溢的调香师可能不会制作出闻起来像无花果和四川花椒的东西。
他们制造的是流行音乐。

sentences.en: They're trying to make something interesting within the parameters of mainstream taste.
sentences.zh: 他们试图在主流品味的范围内创造出有趣的东西。

sentences.en: Something you'd buy in a Sephora.
sentences.zh: 那种你会从丝芙兰买到的东西。

sentences.en: Or something you'd buy in your grocery store.
sentences.zh: 或者你会从杂货店买到的东西。

sentences.en: Because Mann and the dozen or so major fragrance companies don't just make perfume.
sentences.zh: 因为曼恩和那十几家主要的香氛公司不仅仅制造香水。

sentences.en: They work on every product that has a smell.
sentences.zh: 他们参与所有有气味的产品。

sentences.en: Home care, cleaning, laundry, personal care.
sentences.zh: 家居护理、清洁、洗衣、个人护理。

sentences.en: Suzanne McCormick is the head of fragrance for Method Products.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·麦考密克是 Method Products 公司的香氛主管。

sentences.en: They make soap and detergent and body wash.
sentences.zh: 他们生产肥皂、洗涤剂和沐浴露。

sentences.en: And they work with two of the major fragrance houses.
sentences.zh: 他们与两家主要的香氛公司合作。

sentences.en: Because I kid you not, it is just the same small handful of companies that are crafting all the scents all around us.
sentences.zh: 因为我没骗你，确实就是那几家小公司在制造我们周围所有的香味。

sentences.en: And this overlap means that trends in high-end perfume affect your dish soap.
sentences.zh: 这种重叠意味着高端香水的趋势会影响你的洗洁精。
这是一种自上而下的渗透。

sentences.en: It's just like how high-end fashion designers will create a look that eventually ends up at H&M.
sentences.zh: 就像高端时装设计师创造的造型最终会出现在 H&M 一样。

sentences.en: If a fragrance company develops an accord that sells really well,
sentences.zh: 如果一家香氛公司开发出一种非常畅销的香协，

sentences.en: that scent might eventually end up in your face cream or your laundry detergent.
sentences.zh: 那种香味最终可能会出现在你的面霜或洗衣液中。

sentences.en: Rose had been considered the older fragrance note.
sentences.zh: 玫瑰曾被认为是较老派的香调。

sentences.en: And then all the fine fragrance, many fine fragrance brands were bringing it to life in a modern way.
sentences.zh: 然后所有的精品香水品牌都以现代的方式赋予了它生命。

sentences.en: And then as you trickle down to our body wash, we have peony, rose water.
sentences.zh: 随着这种趋势渗透到我们的沐浴露中，我们有了牡丹和玫瑰水。

sentences.en: And a while back there was sea salt and everything.
sentences.zh: 前阵子还有海盐之类的东西。

sentences.en: So we did lime and sea salt was one of our fragrances that we did that continued to do very well.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做了青柠和海盐，这是我们持续畅销的香型之一。

sentences.en: And so, these scent companies are everywhere, making you, your kitchen, and your bathroom smell like citrus and lavender and rose.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些香氛公司无处不在，让你、你的厨房和浴室闻起来像柑橘、薰衣草和玫瑰。

sentences.en: But this idea of our bodies smelling somewhat interchangeably with our fabric softener and our dishes is relatively recent.
sentences.zh: 但这种我们的身体闻起来与织物柔软剂和餐具气味几乎可以互换的想法是相对较新的。

sentences.en: We used to have a wildly different concept of what it meant to smell good.
sentences.zh: 我们过去对“好闻”的概念有着截然不同的理解。

sentences.en: I guess I could start with the perfumes that shocked me the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以从那些最让我震惊的香水开始说起。

sentences.en: And they were the perfumes of the 20s, 30s, and 40s.
sentences.zh: 那就是 20 年代、30 年代和 40 年代的香水。

sentences.en: Barbara Herman is the creative director of Eris Parfum and the author of the book Scent and Subversion.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·赫尔曼是 Eris Parfum 的创意总监，也是《气味与颠覆》一书的作者。

sentences.en: I like to describe what I did in this book was sniff my way through the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样描述我在书中所做的事情：我嗅着走过了整个 20 世纪。

sentences.en: What we think people should smell like is completely cultural.
sentences.zh: 我们认为人们应该闻起来是什么味道，这完全是文化决定的。
而且它随着时间的推移而改变。

sentences.en: In the 1920s, 30s, and 40s, women were marketed perfumes that were more funky.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 20、30 和 40 年代，向女性推销的香水更加“时髦”且独特。

sentences.en: Women smelled like tobacco and leather.
sentences.zh: 女性闻起来像烟草和皮革。

sentences.en: And, you know, as Jacques Guerlain said about his perfumes,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，正如雅克·娇兰谈到他的香水时所说，

sentences.en: perfumes should smell like the underside of my mistress.
sentences.zh: 香水应该闻起来像我情妇的私处。

sentences.en: There was this idea that perfume was supposed to smell funky.
sentences.zh: 当时有一种观念认为香水就应该闻起来有那种独特的味道。

sentences.en: Perfumes had ingredients like ambergris, which is oxidized whale vomit,
sentences.zh: 香水含有龙涎香等成分，也就是氧化的鲸鱼呕吐物，

sentences.en: and musk, which is deer sex gland secretion.
sentences.zh: 还有麝香，也就是鹿的性腺分泌物。

sentences.en: Now these kinds of smells are made synthetically.
sentences.zh: 现在这些气味都是人工合成的。

sentences.en: But in the early 20th century, people wore the real stuff.
sentences.zh: 但在 20 世纪初，人们用的是真货。

sentences.en: Which sounds off-putting, but actually, these smells are fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很倒胃口，但实际上，这些气味非常迷人。

sentences.en: Barbara happened to have some real ambergris in her refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉碰巧在她的冰箱里放了一些真正的龙涎香。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a very, very hard scent to describe.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一种非常、非常难描述的气味。

sentences.en: Some people say there's tobacco note.
sentences.zh: 有些人说有一种烟草味。

sentences.en: There's obviously a very animalic kind of fecal quality to it,
sentences.zh: 显然它有一种非常动物性的、类似粪便的特质。

sentences.en: but also slightly metallic and coumarin or, like, hay-like, slightly sweet.
sentences.zh: 但同时也带有一点金属味和香豆素味，或者说，像干草味，略带甜味。

sentences.en: It's more of a feeling than it is a smell for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这更像是一种感觉，而不是一种气味。

sentences.en: It's just, like, being enveloped in warmth.
sentences.zh: 就像是被温暖包裹着一样。

sentences.en: I'm, like, looking at a landscape through a pinhole.
sentences.zh: 我就像是透过针孔在看风景。

sentences.en: Oh, can I see more of it?
That's a good way to describe it.
I wish I could stick my head in a box full of it.
sentences.zh: 真想把头埋进装满这种东西的盒子里。

sentences.en: For all those weird and gross descriptors,
sentences.zh: 尽管有那么多奇怪又恶心的描述，

sentences.en: Most scents, especially naturally occurring ones,
sentences.zh: 大多数气味，尤其是自然界中存在的气味，

sentences.en: are way more nuanced and strange than we'd like to believe.
sentences.zh: 比我们愿意相信的要微妙和奇特得多。

sentences.en: I know, I sound like a psychopath,
sentences.zh: 我知道，我听起来像个变态，

sentences.en: but there's a really fuzzy line between delicious and off-putting,
sentences.zh: 但美味与反感之间的界限真的很模糊，

sentences.en: if you pay attention to your nose
sentences.zh: 只要你留意自己的嗅觉，

sentences.en: and forget the fact that this may be whale barf.
sentences.zh: 并忽略这可能是鲸鱼呕吐物的事实。

sentences.en: and a lot of, you know, subliminal, unconscious effects.
sentences.zh: 而且带有很多，你知道的，潜意识的、无意识的影响。

sentences.en: I can't put them all into words,
sentences.zh: 我无法用言语完全表达出来，

sentences.en: but if you've experienced them and if you're open to them,
sentences.zh: 但如果你体验过，并且愿意去感受，

sentences.en: you'll know exactly what I'm talking about.
sentences.zh: 你就会明白我在说什么。

sentences.en: And it's interesting that people in the 1920s, 30s, and 40s
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，20世纪20、30和40年代的人们，

sentences.en: were more willing to wear these strong,
sentences.zh: 更愿意使用这些浓烈的、

sentences.en: It's particularly interesting that they were marketed to women.
sentences.zh: 特别有趣的是，这些香水当时是针对女性销售的。

sentences.en: On the one hand, it's kind of empowering and bold and sensuous,
sentences.zh: 一方面，这显得很有力量、大胆且性感，

sentences.en: but it also meant these women weren't exactly
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着这些女性并不是

sentences.en: dousing themselves to go to board meetings.
sentences.zh: 喷着香水去参加董事会会议的。

sentences.en: These were scents for the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 这些是属于卧室的香水。

sentences.en: And our idea of what femininity should smell like
sentences.zh: 而我们对女性应该是什么味道的认知，
在20世纪50年代发生了演变，

sentences.en: when a lot of bright and powdery scents came out.
sentences.zh: 当时出现了许多明亮且带有粉感的香水。
非常像多丽丝·戴（Doris Day）那种活泼风格。

sentences.en: Florals, huge ass, white florals, screaming.
sentences.zh: 花香调，超大剂量的白花香，简直在尖叫。

sentences.en: And then, like everything else in culture,
sentences.zh: 然后，就像文化中的其他事物一样，

sentences.en: scent was subverted by the time you get to the 70s,
sentences.zh: 到了70年代，香水被颠覆了，

sentences.en: when there was this natural wave of oak moss and patchouli.
sentences.zh: 当时掀起了一股橡木苔和广藿香的自然风潮。

sentences.en: Then the 1980s were about big, bold fragrances,
sentences.zh: 接着80年代流行的是浓郁、大胆的香水，

sentences.en: the kind that, as Rachel Syme puts it, could clear an elevator.
sentences.zh: 正如瑞秋·赛姆（Rachel Syme）所说，那种能让电梯里的人都散开的味道。

sentences.en: And then, there was a very important pendulum swing in the 1990s,
sentences.zh: 然后，90年代出现了一个非常重要的钟摆式转变，

sentences.en: a sea change that mainstream sensibilities

sentences.zh: 都还没缓过劲来的巨变。

sentences.en: The 90s was generally the clean decade.
This is when perfumes like CK1 came out for men and for women.
sentences.zh: 那时CK1之类的香水问世，男女皆宜。

sentences.en: There was this wave of clean smells
sentences.zh: 当时掀起了一股洁净气味的浪潮，

sentences.en: that were light and fresh and inoffensive.
sentences.zh: 轻盈、清新且不具侵略性。

sentences.en: They made you smell like you just showered.
sentences.zh: 它们让你闻起来就像刚洗完澡一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there's some great clean perfumes.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我是说，确实有一些很棒的洁净感香水。

sentences.en: Like, don't get me wrong, I love to rag on them,
sentences.zh: 别误会，我喜欢吐槽它们，

sentences.en: but I just think that what perfume meant in the past
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得香水在过去意味着什么，

sentences.en: and what it means now is very different.
sentences.zh: 和它现在意味着什么，是非常不同的。

sentences.en: Clean scents took off in a major way.
A lot of money in them.
And when perfume just became kind of generally pleasant
sentences.zh: 当香水变得普遍令人愉悦

sentences.en: more and more companies felt comfortable
sentences.zh: 越来越多的公司觉得可以放心地

sentences.en: yoking their prized brand name to it.
sentences.zh: 把他们珍视的品牌名称与之挂钩。
工业化香水创作的世界，

sentences.en: when perfumes just got, like, mass-produced.
sentences.zh: 那时香水开始变得像大众消费品一样被批量生产。

sentences.en: we are still stuck there in the fresh and clean era,
sentences.zh: 我们仍然困在那种清新洁净的时代，

sentences.en: Yeah, to smell is to be sensual
sentences.zh: 是啊，有气味就意味着感性，

sentences.en: or to be erotic or dirty.
That's why fresh and clean is such a big deal in this country.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么“清新洁净”在这个国家如此重要。
莫纳汉的米兰达·戈登（Miranda Gordon）。

sentences.en: In France, you're sexy if you're a little funky.
sentences.zh: 在法国，如果你带点独特的体味，反而很性感。

sentences.en: Here, you've got to be freshly showered
sentences.zh: 在这里，你必须刚洗完澡，
闻起来什么味道都没有。

sentences.en: if you do want to smell like nothing at all,
sentences.zh: 如果你真的想闻起来什么味道都没有，

sentences.en: Because even when you're buying a product
sentences.zh: 因为即使你购买标有“无香精”的产品，
一个标有“无香精”的产品，
我们必须给它添加香料，

sentences.en: and we had to fragrance it
sentences.zh: 以掩盖产品中功能性成分

sentences.en: in order to cover up the malodors
of the functional things in your products.
sentences.zh: 里面可能确实加了东西，

sentences.en: it's what we call a masking odor

sentences.zh: 可能存在的任何鱼腥味、

sentences.en: the ingredients in your face cream might have.
sentences.zh: 因为地球上大多数东西

sentences.en: Because most things on this earth

sentences.zh: 只是整个行业已经发展到

sentences.en: It's just that an industry has developed
sentences.zh: 专门去规避那些奇怪的气味。
我们只想闻起来清新洁净，

sentences.en: We want to smell fresh and clean

sentences.zh: 主流香水市场几十年来一直困在“洁净”热潮中。

sentences.en: the mainstream perfume market's been stuck
in the clean boom for some decades now.
sentences.zh: 发生了一场静悄悄的革命。

sentences.en: But there's been a quiet revolution

sentences.zh: 独立香水圈已经蓬勃发展起来。
好了，现在我们要闻闻“番茄皮革”。
这本意就是这两种气味的字面结合。

sentences.en: Okay, so now we're going to smell tomato leather.
sentences.zh: 在她的旧金山香水店“Tiger Lily”，

sentences.zh: 安东尼娅·科尔（Antonia Cole）销售的香水

sentences.en: At her San Francisco perfume store,
sentences.zh: 这款香水的灵感来源于版画工作室
灵感来源于埃及的来世之神，
以及她想象中陵墓里会有的气味。

sentences.en: This fragrance is inspired by the printmaker's studio

sentences.zh: 前往西雅图时闻到的味道。

sentences.en: Inspired by the god of the afterlife in Egypt
sentences.zh: 店里还有很多更不寻常的香水。

sentences.en: and the smell she imagined would be inside the tomb.
sentences.zh: 我们有闻起来像篝火的，还有……

when you're waiting for the ferry
sentences.zh: 成千上万的独立调香师

sentences.en: There's so many more unusual scents in the store.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人都在进行艺术冒险，
